summary: Bluff tower west of Montgomery, Alabama, with a 12x12 ft cab; the site was later used for a water tank. Only the FFLOS register describes it.

facts.design: Fire tower with a 12'x12' cab (tower type not stated)
facts.status_note: Removed; the register says the site was later reused for a water tank

events.note: Registered January 16, 2016 as US 1612, AL 2; nominated by Al Pelham

evidence.supports: location: bluff west of Montgomery, Montgomery County
evidence.quote: Located on a bluff west of Montgomery, Cantelou Fire Tower sported a 12'x12' cab.

evidence.supports: site reused for a water tank after tower removal
evidence.quote: The site was reused for a water tank following the fire tower's removal.

notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLOS register page. Two WebSearch queries and the FFLOS Alabama report (cr-al-2018.pdf) turned up no history of this tower; the search lead TopoQuest 'Cantelou Lookout Tower' was not fetched and is not cited. Alabama Mosaic photo record ADAHphoto25939 failed with an SSL verify error. No build, removal, staffing, fire or access dates are in any source read, so events are limited to the 2016 registration. The story sits near the 120-word floor because the register is the only source.
